title: Concept: Crate dependency declared by major version only
description: Cargo.toml declares a version string that is a bare major number, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a version string that is a bare major number.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a version string that is a bare major number.
